```{r compare global RSL and rates optimal model ensemble to chosen model}
  scale_x_reverse()+
  scale_color_hawaii(discrete=TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  scale_fill_hawaii(discrete = TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  labs(x='Age (yrs BP)',y='RSL rate (mm/yr)')

p = cowplot::plot_grid(p1,p2,nrow=2,align='hv')
p

ggsave('figures/ESTGP_compare_global_chosen_to_full_ensemble.pdf',p,height=5,width=7)

```

Therefore, we use the chosen model in the eventual analysis (Figure 3), comparing to RSL data.

We compare the global component of RSL and rate (based on the optimal ensemble) to the RSL data.

```{r compare chosen global EST-GP NIspline and EIVIGP models to RSL data}

# factor levels for plotting
model_colors <- c(
  'EIV-IGP' = '#9b951bff',
  'NI spline' = '#b2f2fdff',
  'EST-GP (global)' = '#8c0172ff'
)


# load RSL data
BelizeDatabase = readxl::read_xlsx('data/BelizeDatabase_6Aug2025.xlsx') %>% mutate(Tectonic=as.factor(Tectonic),Quality=as.factor(Quality))

# load our record
GR19C1 = read.csv('results/SLIPs/RSLallages_Bchron_EIVIGPinput.csv')

# tidy for plotting
scale=1.5

SLIPs= filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==0)
SLIPs$upper = SLIPs$RSL + SLIPs$RSL_up_er_2sd # ymax value
SLIPs$lower = SLIPs$RSL - SLIPs$RSL_low_er_2sd # ymin value
SLIPs$left = SLIPs$Age - SLIPs$Age_low_er_2sd  # xmin value
SLIPs$right = SLIPs$Age + SLIPs$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

marL=filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==-1)
marL$upper = marL$RSL - marL$RSL_low_er_2sd # y value of horizontal line
marL$lower = marL$upper - scale # y value for bottom of tick mark
marL$xmid = marL$Age
marL$left = marL$Age-marL$Age_low_er_2sd # xmin value
marL$right = marL$Age+marL$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

terrL=filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==1)
terrL$lower = terrL$RSL + terrL$RSL_up_er_2sd # y value of horizontal line
terrL$upper = terrL$lower + scale # y value for top of tick mark
terrL$xmid = terrL$Age
terrL$left = terrL$Age-terrL$Age_low_er_2sd # xmin value
terrL$right = terrL$Age+terrL$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

# load NIspline model results for GR19C1
GR19C1_NIspline = read.csv('results/ReSLR NIspline model outputs/GR19C1 NIspline model nseg14.csv') %>% mutate(model='NI spline') %>% mutate(model=factor(model))

# load EIV-IGP model results for GR19C1
GR19C1_EIVIGP = read.csv('results/EIV-IGP model outputs/GR19C1_EIVIGP_defaultsettings.csv') %>% mutate(model='EIV-IGP') %>% mutate(model=factor(model))

# load RSL and rate outputs
ESTGP_RSL_chosen=read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_TwoComponents/RSL.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(RSL=RSL/1000,RSLsd=RSLsd/1000,model='EST-GP (global)') %>%
  mutate(model=factor(model,levels=model_levels))

ESTGP_Rates_chosen = read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_TwoComponents/RSLrates.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(df2s=df2s,dsd2s=dsd2s,model='EST-GP (global)') %>%
  mutate(model=factor(model,levels=model_levels))

p_BelizeRSL=
  ggplot()+
  # plot existing data
  geom_rect(data=SLIPs, # recalibrated
            aes(xmin = left, xmax = right, ymin = lower, ymax = upper,
                linetype=Quality,alpha=Quality),
            linewidth=0.4,fill='#bf812d',color='#bf812d')+
  geom_segment(data=terrL, # horizontal line
               mapping = aes(x=left,xend=right,y=lower,yend=lower,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='forestgreen',linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_segment(data=terrL, # vertical tick mark
               mapping = aes(x=xmid,xend=xmid,y=lower,yend=upper,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='forestgreen',linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_segment(data=marL, # horizontal line
               mapping = aes(x=left,xend=right,y=upper,yend=upper,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='blue',linewidth=0.4)+
  geom_segment(data=marL, # vertical tick mark
               mapping = aes(x=xmid,xend=xmid,y=lower,yend=upper,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='blue',linewidth=0.4)+
  # plot our record
  geom_rect(data=GR19C1,aes(xmin=Age-Age_up_er_2sd,
                xmax=Age+Age_up_er_2sd,
                ymin=RSL-RSLer_up_2sd,
                ymax=RSL+RSLer_up_2sd),alpha=0.8,fill=NA,linewidth=0.3,color='black') +
  # plot spatiotemporal model global component
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_RSL_chosen,
            aes(y=RSL,x=yearBP,color=model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_RSL_chosen,
              aes(ymin=RSL-2*RSLsd,ymax=RSL+2*RSLsd,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  # plot EIV-IGP model
  geom_ribbon(data=GR19C1_EIVIGP, aes(x=Age_BP,ymin=lwr,ymax=upr,fill=model),alpha=0.5) + # 2 sigma
  geom_path(data=GR19C1_EIVIGP,aes(x=Age_BP,y=pred,color=model))+
  # plot NIspline model
  geom_ribbon(data=GR19C1_NIspline, aes(x=Age_BP,ymin=lwr,ymax=upr,fill=model),alpha=0.5) + # 2 sigma
  geom_path(data=GR19C1_NIspline,aes(x=Age_BP,y=pred,color=model))+
  # plot start of GR/19/C1 record
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=max(GR19C1$Age)),linetype='dashed')+
  scale_color_manual(values=model_colors)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=model_colors)+
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c(0.5,0.1))+
  labs(x='Age (yrs BP)',y='RSL (m)')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = 'top')+
  scale_x_reverse(breaks=seq(0,13000,1000),limits=c(13500,-100))

  # Find timing of GR19C1 initiation and rate threshold
GR19C1_initiation = max(GR19C1$Age)
ESTGP_coincide_GR19C1=filter(ESTGP_Rates_chosen,yearBP<=GR19C1_initiation)
thresholdrate = slice(filter(ESTGP_coincide_GR19C1,df2s == max(df2s)),1) 
  
p_BelizeRSLrates =
  ggplot() +
    # EST-GP (global model chosen model summary statistics)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen,
            aes(y=df2s,x=yearBP,color=model),linewidth=0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen,
              aes(ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  # EIV-IGP
   geom_ribbon(data=GR19C1_EIVIGP, # 2 sigma
              aes(x=Age_BP,
                  ymin=rate_lwr,
                  ymax=rate_upr,
                  fill=model),
              alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(data=GR19C1_EIVIGP,
            aes(x=Age_BP,
                y=rate_pred,
                color=model), linewidth=0.8) +
  # NISpline
   geom_ribbon(data=GR19C1_NIspline, # 2 sigma
              aes(x=Age_BP,
                  ymin=rate_lwr,
                  ymax=rate_upr,fill=model),
              alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(data=GR19C1_NIspline,
            aes(x=Age_BP,
                y=rate_pred,color=model), linewidth=0.8) +
  # plot start of GR/19/C1 record
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=max(GR19C1$Age)),linetype='dashed')+
  # plot threshold rate at the time of GR/19/C1 initiation
  geom_rect(data=thresholdrate,
            aes(ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,
                ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,
                xmin=13500,xmax=0),
            fill='grey50',alpha=0.15) +
  geom_segment(data=thresholdrate,
               aes(y=df2s,yend=df2s,x=13500,xend=0),
               color ='grey50',alpha=0.15) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks=seq(0,13000,1000),
                  limits=c(13500,-100))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-5,18,3))+
  scale_color_manual(values=model_colors)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=model_colors)+
  labs(x="Age (BP)",y="Rate (mm/yr)") 

p_Belize = cowplot::plot_grid(p_BelizeRSL,p_BelizeRSLrates,nrow=2,align='hv')
p_Belize

ggsave('Figures/Belize RSL compare GR19C1.pdf',p_Belize,height=7,width=6)
```

We decompose the RSL trends in Belize into the global, regional and local components using the chosen model.

```{r plot spatiotemporal decomposition, warning=FALSE}
# load RSL data
BelizeDatabase = readxl::read_xlsx('data/BelizeDatabase_6Aug2025.xlsx') %>% mutate(Tectonic=as.factor(Tectonic),                                        
                                                                            Quality=as.factor(Quality),
                                                                                component='Full') %>% mutate(component=factor(component,levels=c('Full','Global','Regional','Local')))


# load our record
GR19C1 = read.csv('results/SLIPs/RSLallages_Bchron_EIVIGPinput.csv') %>% mutate(component='Full') %>% mutate(component=factor(component,levels=c('Full','Global','Regional','Local')))

# tidy for plotting
scale=1.5

SLIPs= filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==0)
SLIPs$upper = SLIPs$RSL + SLIPs$RSL_up_er_2sd # ymax value
SLIPs$lower = SLIPs$RSL - SLIPs$RSL_low_er_2sd # ymin value
SLIPs$left = SLIPs$Age - SLIPs$Age_low_er_2sd  # xmin value
SLIPs$right = SLIPs$Age + SLIPs$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

marL=filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==-1)
marL$upper = marL$RSL - marL$RSL_low_er_2sd # y value of horizontal line
marL$lower = marL$upper - scale # y value for bottom of tick mark
marL$xmid = marL$Age
marL$left = marL$Age-marL$Age_low_er_2sd # xmin value
marL$right = marL$Age+marL$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

terrL=filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==1)
terrL$lower = terrL$RSL + terrL$RSL_up_er_2sd # y value of horizontal line
terrL$upper = terrL$lower + scale # y value for top of tick mark
terrL$xmid = terrL$Age
terrL$left = terrL$Age-terrL$Age_low_er_2sd # xmin value
terrL$right = terrL$Age+terrL$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value


# load RSL and rate outputs from EST-GP model global component
ESTGP_RSL_chosen = read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_TwoComponents/RSL.csv') %>% filter(model_ranking==0) %>% filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>% mutate(siteID=as.factor(siteID)) %>% mutate(RSL=RSL/1000,RSLsd=RSLsd/1000)
ESTGP_Rates_chosen = read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_TwoComponents/RSLrates.csv') %>% filter(model_ranking==0) %>% filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>% mutate(siteID=as.factor(siteID))

# rename components to text 
ESTGP_RSL_chosen <- ESTGP_RSL_chosen %>%
  mutate(component = case_when(
    component == "1" ~ "Full",
    component == "2" ~ "Global",
    component == "3" ~ "Local")) %>% mutate(component=factor(component,levels=c('Full','Global','Local')))
ESTGP_Rates_chosen <- ESTGP_Rates_chosen %>%
  mutate(component = case_when(
    component == "1" ~ "Full",
    component == "2" ~ "Global",
    component == "3" ~ "Local")) %>% mutate(component=factor(component,levels=c('Full','Global','Local')))

p_RSL = ggplot() +
  # plot existing data
  geom_rect(data=SLIPs, # recalibrated
            aes(xmin = left, xmax = right, ymin = lower, ymax = upper,linetype=Quality,alpha=Quality),
            linewidth=0.4,fill='transparent',color='grey80')+
  geom_segment(data=terrL, # horizontal line
               mapping = aes(x=left,xend=right,y=lower,yend=lower,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='forestgreen',linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_segment(data=terrL, # vertical tick mark
               mapping = aes(x=xmid,xend=xmid,y=lower,yend=upper,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='forestgreen',linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_segment(data=marL, # horizontal line
               mapping = aes(x=left,xend=right,y=upper,yend=upper,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='blue',linewidth=0.4)+
  geom_segment(data=marL, # vertical tick mark
               mapping = aes(x=xmid,xend=xmid,y=lower,yend=upper,alpha=Quality,linetype=Quality),
               color='blue',linewidth=0.4)+
  # plot our record
  geom_rect(data=GR19C1,aes(xmin=Age-Age_up_er_2sd,
                xmax=Age+Age_up_er_2sd,
                ymin=RSL-RSLer_up_2sd,
                ymax=RSL+RSLer_up_2sd),alpha=0.8,fill=NA,linewidth=0.3,color='grey20') +
  # EST-GP Global component
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_RSL_chosen, 
              aes(x=yearBP,
                  ymin=RSL-RSLsd,
                  ymax=RSL+RSLsd,fill=siteID),
              alpha=0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_RSL_chosen, 
              aes(x=yearBP,
                  ymin=RSL-2*RSLsd,
                  ymax=RSL+2*RSLsd,fill=siteID),

  geom_line(data=ESTGP_RSL_chosen,

  # scale_fill_hawaii(discrete=TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  labs(x='Age (kyrs BP)',y='RSL (m)') +
  facet_wrap(~component,nrow=1)


p_rates = ggplot() +

  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen,

                  ymin=df2s-dsd2s,
                  ymax=df2s+dsd2s,fill=siteID),
              alpha=0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen, 
              aes(x=yearBP,
                  ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,
                  ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,fill=siteID),
              alpha=0.3) +
  geom_line(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen,
            aes(x=yearBP,
                y=df2s,color=siteID), linewidth=0.8,na.rm=TRUE) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_x_reverse(limits=c(max(BelizeDatabase$Age+BelizeDatabase$Age_up_er_2sd),min(BelizeDatabase$Age+BelizeDatabase$Age_up_er_2sd)), labels= function(x) x / 1000) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette='Paired')+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette='Paired')+
  # scale_color_hawaii(discrete=TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  # scale_fill_hawaii(discrete=TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  labs(x='Age (kyrs BP)',y='Rate (mm/yr)') +
  facet_wrap(~component,nrow=1)

p_decomp = cowplot::plot_grid(p_RSL,p_rates,nrow=2,align='hv')
p_decomp

ggsave('Figures/Belize RSL decomposition.pdf',p_decomp,height=6,width=10)

ESTGP_RSL_chosen_local = filter(ESTGP_RSL_chosen,component=='Local')

paste('Local scale processes contribute on average',

      'm (2 sigma) to the total RSL.')
```

```{r plot spatiotemporal model decomposition by regions Response to Reviewer}
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Dark2')+
  labs(x='Age (BP)',y='RSL (m)') +
  facet_wrap(~siteID,nrow=3)

p_rates = ggplot() +
  # Ashe et al. 2019 Global component
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen, 
              aes(x=yearBP,
                  ymin=df2s-dsd2s,
                  ymax=df2s+dsd2s,fill=component),
              alpha=0.5) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen, 
              aes(x=yearBP,
                  ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,
                  ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,fill=component),
              alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(data=ESTGP_Rates_chosen,
            aes(x=yearBP,
                y=df2s,color=component), linewidth=0.8,na.rm=TRUE) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_x_reverse(limits=c(max(BelizeDatabase$Age+BelizeDatabase$Age_up_er_2sd)+100,min(BelizeDatabase$Age-BelizeDatabase$Age_up_er_2sd)-100)) +
  scale_color_hawaii(discrete=TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  scale_fill_hawaii(discrete=TRUE,scale_name='hawaii')+
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Dark2')+
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Dark2')+
  labs(x='Age (BP)',y='Rate (mm/yr)') +
  facet_wrap(~siteID,nrow=3)

p=cowplot::plot_grid(p_RSL,p_rates,nrow=2,align='hv')
p

ggsave('Figures/Belize RSL decomposition by region.pdf',p,height=8,width=8)

```


## Compare different data inputs for EST-GP (response to Reviewer 3)

Reviewer 3 raised concerns that the continuous core data was combined with SLIPs in a GP model.To answer this we test two variations of the spatiotemporal (EST-GP) model:

1) with the GR/19/C1 core classified as an independent site as the other Twin Cays SLIPs
2) with the GR/19/C1 core as SLIPs instead of using the age output from the age-depth model

We compare the global component as this is the main model component referred to and also comprises most of the signal.

```{r compare EST-GP with GR19C1 core classified as different site or as SLIPs}
# load RSL data
BelizeDatabase = readxl::read_xlsx('data/BelizeDatabase_6Aug2025.xlsx') %>% mutate(Tectonic=as.factor(Tectonic),Quality=as.factor(Quality))

# load our record
GR19C1 = read.csv('results/SLIPs/RSLallages_Bchron_EIVIGPinput.csv')

# tidy for plotting
scale=1.5

SLIPs= filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==0)
SLIPs$upper = SLIPs$RSL + SLIPs$RSL_up_er_2sd # ymax value
SLIPs$lower = SLIPs$RSL - SLIPs$RSL_low_er_2sd # ymin value
SLIPs$left = SLIPs$Age - SLIPs$Age_low_er_2sd  # xmin value
SLIPs$right = SLIPs$Age + SLIPs$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

marL=filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==-1)
marL$upper = marL$RSL - marL$RSL_low_er_2sd # y value of horizontal line
marL$lower = marL$upper - scale # y value for bottom of tick mark
marL$xmid = marL$Age
marL$left = marL$Age-marL$Age_low_er_2sd # xmin value
marL$right = marL$Age+marL$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

terrL=filter(BelizeDatabase,Type==1)
terrL$lower = terrL$RSL + terrL$RSL_up_er_2sd # y value of horizontal line
terrL$upper = terrL$lower + scale # y value for top of tick mark
terrL$xmid = terrL$Age
terrL$left = terrL$Age-terrL$Age_low_er_2sd # xmin value
terrL$right = terrL$Age+terrL$Age_up_er_2sd # xmax value

# define factor levels for plotting
FactorLevels = c('EST-GP (global)','EST-GP (global) split TwinCays','EST-GP (global) GR19C1 as SLIPs')

# load original EST-GP outputs
ESTGP_RSL=read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize/RSL.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(RSL=RSL/1000,RSLsd=RSLsd/1000,
         model=factor('EST-GP (global)',levels=FactorLevels)) 
ESTGP_Rates = read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize/RSLrates.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(df2s=df2s,dsd2s=dsd2s,
         model=factor('EST-GP (global)',levels=FactorLevels)) 

# load variation of EST-GP: split GR19C1 as separate site
ESTGP_RSL_splitTWC=read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_testSplitTWC/RSL.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(RSL=RSL/1000,RSLsd=RSLsd/1000,
         model=factor('EST-GP (global) split TwinCays',levels=FactorLevels)) 
ESTGP_Rates_splitTWC = read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_testSplitTWC/RSLrates.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(df2s=df2s,dsd2s=dsd2s,
         model=factor('EST-GP (global) split TwinCays',levels=FactorLevels)) 

# load variation of EST-GP: treat GR19C1 as SLIPs
ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs=read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_testGR19C1asSLIPs/RSL.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(RSL=RSL/1000,RSLsd=RSLsd/1000,
         model=factor('EST-GP (global) GR19C1 as SLIPs',levels=FactorLevels)) 
ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs = read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_testGR19C1asSLIPs/RSLrates.csv') %>% 
  filter(component==2 & model_ranking==0) %>% 
  filter(yearBP<=max(SLIPs$Age)) %>%
  mutate(df2s=df2s,dsd2s=dsd2s,
         model=factor('EST-GP (global) GR19C1 as SLIPs',levels=FactorLevels)) 

# plot global component comparison
p_BelizeRSL=
  ggplot()+
  # plot spatiotemporal model global component (original data)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_RSL,
            aes(y=RSL,x=yearBP,color=model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_RSL,
              aes(ymin=RSL-2*RSLsd,ymax=RSL+2*RSLsd,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  # plot spatiotemporal model global component (split GR/19/C1 core from Twin Cays SLIPs)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_RSL_splitTWC,
            aes(y=RSL,x=yearBP,color=model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_RSL_splitTWC,
              aes(ymin=RSL-2*RSLsd,ymax=RSL+2*RSLsd,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  # plot spatiotemporal model global component (treat GR/19/C1 core as SLIPs)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs,
            aes(y=RSL,x=yearBP,color=model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs,
              aes(ymin=RSL-2*RSLsd,ymax=RSL+2*RSLsd,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  scale_fill_brewer(palette='Dark2')+
  scale_color_brewer(palette='Dark2')+
  # scale_color_hawaii(discrete=TRUE) + 
  # scale_fill_hawaii(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values=c(0.5,0.1))+
  labs(x='Age (yrs BP)',y='RSL (m)')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position = 'top')+
  scale_x_reverse(breaks=seq(0,13000,1000),limits=c(13500,-100)) +
  ggtitle('Global component')
  
 p_BelizeRSLrates =
  ggplot() +
  # EST-GP (global model chosen model original)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_Rates,
            aes(y=df2s,x=yearBP,color=model),linewidth=0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates,
              aes(ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  # EST-GP (global model chosen model split Twin Cays data)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_Rates_splitTWC,
            aes(y=df2s,x=yearBP,color=model),linewidth=0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_splitTWC,
              aes(ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
   # EST-GP (global model chosen model treat GR19C1 as SLIPs)
  geom_path(data=ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs,
            aes(y=df2s,x=yearBP,color=model),linewidth=0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data=ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs,
              aes(ymin=df2s-2*dsd2s,ymax=df2s+2*dsd2s,x=yearBP,fill=model),alpha=0.35) + # 2 sigma
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks=seq(0,13000,1000),
                  limits=c(13500,-100))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-5,18,3))+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette='Dark2')+
  scale_color_brewer(palette='Dark2')+
  # scale_color_hawaii() +
  # scale_fill_hawaii() +
  labs(x="Age (BP)",y="Rate (mm/yr)") 

p_Belize = cowplot::plot_grid(p_BelizeRSL,p_BelizeRSLrates,nrow=2,align='hv')
p_Belize

ggsave('Figures/ESTGP_compare_inputs_ResponseReviewer3_SplitSitesAndSLIPs.pdf',p_Belize,height=7,width=6)
```

```{r plot decomposition of model using SLIPs approach treating GR19C1 as SLIPs)}

# load model results
ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs=read.csv('results/Erica STeHM/Belize_testGR19C1asSLIPs/RSL.csv') %>%

# convert component from number to text
ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(1,ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Full'
ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(2,ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Global'
ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(3,ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Regional'
ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(4,ESTGP_RSL_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Local'

ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(2,ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Global'
ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(3,ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Regional'
ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs$component[which(grepl(4,ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs$component)==TRUE)]='Local'

ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs = ESTGP_Rates_GR19C1asSLIPs %>% mutate(component=factor(component,levels=c('Full','Global','Regional','Local')))

# plot RSL
```

In response to Reviewer 3, we collapsed the regional and local kernels into one.

## Compare EST-GP with PaleoSTeHM (not published, for Yucheng)
We compare the EST-GP model results to Paleo-STeHM results, to assess if the two models produce similar results.

```{r compare EST-GP to PaleoSTeHM}

  mutate(Age=Age/1000,Age_up_er_2sd=Age_up_er_2sd/1000,Age_low_er_2sd=Age_low_er_2sd/1000)
```

# Comparison with IPCC AR6 projections

```{r extract IPCC median rate for SSP5-85 in 2030 as netcdf}

# produce for all medium confidence projections only
filelist=as.list(list.files('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/raw/')[which(grepl('low',list.files('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/raw/'))==FALSE)])

# function to extract milestone timings for each medium confidence projection
extractIPCC2030Rate = function(y){

 # open file
  filepath=paste0('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/raw/',y)
  nc = nc_open(filepath)
  
  # load dimensions
  locations = ncvar_get(nc,"locations")
  years = ncvar_get(nc,"years")
  quantiles = ncvar_get(nc,"quantiles")
  
  # load lat and lon
  lat = ncvar_get(nc,"lat")
  lon =  ncvar_get(nc,"lon")
  
  # filter to only median for the year 2030 and get associated rate at all locations
  medianID = which(quantiles==0.5)
  yearID = which(years==2030)
  rate = ncvar_get(nc,"sea_level_change_rate")[,yearID,medianID] # locations, years, quantiles

  # now format to export as netcdf 
  
  # Define dimensions (each point is a unique location)
  loc_dim = ncdim_def("location", "", 1:length(rate))
  
  # Define variables for lat, lon, and rate
  lon_var = ncvar_def("lon", "degrees_east", list(loc_dim), 
                       missval = NA, prec = "double")
  lat_var = ncvar_def("lat", "degrees_north", list(loc_dim), 
                       missval = NA, prec = "double")
  rate_var = ncvar_def("sea_level_change_rate", "mm/yr", list(loc_dim),
                        missval = NA, prec = "double")
    
  # Create output file
  out_file = paste0('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/processed/IPCC_2030_medianrate_',substr(y,7,23),'.nc')
  # out_file = "data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/IPCC_median_SL_rate_2030.nc"
  ncnew = nc_create(out_file, list(lon_var, lat_var, rate_var))
  
  # Write data
  ncvar_put(ncnew, lon_var, lon)
  ncvar_put(ncnew, lat_var, lat)
  ncvar_put(ncnew, rate_var, rate)
  
  # (Optional) add metadata
  ncatt_put(ncnew, 0, "title", "IPCC AR6 sea-level change rate (2030, SSP585 medium confidence median estimates)")
  
  # Close file
  nc_close(ncnew)

}


# extract 2030 rate for each medium confidence projection
lapply(X=filelist,FUN=extractIPCC2030Rate)
```


```{r produce map of 2030 median rates in Caribbean, message=FALSE}

# produce for all medium confidence projections only
filelist=as.list(list.files('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/raw/')[which(grepl('low',list.files('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/raw/'))==FALSE)])


# function to extract rates for each medium confidence projection in 2030
extractIPCCRates = function(y){

# open file
  filepath=paste0('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/raw/',y)
  nc = nc_open(filepath)
  
  # load dimensions
  locations = ncvar_get(nc,"locations")
  years = ncvar_get(nc,"years")
  quantiles = ncvar_get(nc,"quantiles")
  
  # load lat and lon
  lat = ncvar_get(nc,"lat")
  lon =  ncvar_get(nc,"lon")
  
  # filter to only median and get associated rate at all locations
  medianID = which(quantiles==0.5)
  locID = which(lon <= -60 & lon >= -100 & lat <= 33 & lat >= 7)
  yearID = which(years==2030)
  rate = ncvar_get(nc,"sea_level_change_rate")[locID,yearID,medianID] # locations, years, quantiles
  
  # now format to export as .csv
  rate_df = data.frame(lon=lon[locID],
                       lat=lat[locID],
                       rate=rate)
  
  # create geopackage
  sfobj = st_as_sf(rate_df, coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326)
  out_file = paste0('data/IPCC AR6/regional_rates/processed/IPCC_2030_median_rate_',substr(y,7,23),'.gpkg')
  st_write(sfobj,
         out_file,
         driver = "GPKG",
         delete_dsn = TRUE,
         layer_options = "GEOMETRY_NAME=geom")

}


# extract milestone timings for each medium confidence projection
lapply(X=filelist,FUN=extractIPCCRates)
```

# Geochemistry

Our modern samples show that d15N and d13C results vary with sub-environments, rather than the location of the study site. 

- In general, d13C values are within the same range as those reported for Puerto Rico mangroves (Khan et al., 2019), but are more depleted than reported in earlier study at Twin Cay (Wooller et al., 2003).

- More positive d13C values are seen in samples near the edge of the mangrove/ boundary of peat collapse, possibly reflecting some input of marine detritus or microbial mat (algae/ seagrass) (Wooller et al., 2003; Khan et al., 2019). 

- However, we do not see strongly enriched d13C (-16 to -20) like that observed in areas with substantial microbial mat (Wooller et al., 2003)

- Basin Rhizophora are more depleted in d15N than fringe Rhizophora. Fringe Rhizophora are N limited, therefore they have higher d15N as they try to maximise all sources of N (McKee et al., 2002). Additionally, d15N may be enriched in fringe zones due to microbial fractionation from nitrification-denitrification, as the soil is intermittently flooded and drained with the tides (McKee et al., 2002). This may explain why the dwarf tree at the channel side had enriched d15N. In contrast, dwarf trees in the island interior (basin Rhizophora) are Phosphorus limited, and their lower d15N values may be related to their slow growth and low demand for N (McKee et al., 2002).

## GR/19/C1 core

The d13C values in our core fall within uncertainty of the present-day values of mangrove sediments from our modern survey.

The depletion of d13C (shift to more negative values) and slight enrichment in d15N towards the base of the core is consistent with decomposition (loss of non-lignin organic matter) (Wooller et al., 2003). 

While the depleted d13C values may also be explained by the presence of dwarf mangroves or black mangroves at the site earlier on, this theory is inconsistent with the positive d15N observed near the base of the core.

```{r geochemistry core}
  # plot core values
  geom_point(data=CN,mapping=aes(x=CN,y=elev_msl)) +
  geom_path(data=CN,mapping=aes(x=CN,y=elev_msl)) +
  # plot uncertainty for core measurements
  geom_segment(data=CN,aes(x=CN-0.2,xend=CN+0.2,y=elev_msl,yend=elev_msl),alpha=0.3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_blank())+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(GR19C1_coretop_MSL-12.14,GR19C1_coretop_MSL))+
  labs(x='C/N')
  

plot=cowplot::plot_grid(p_strat,p_d13C,p_d15N,p_CN, 
                   nrow=1,
                   align='h',
                   rel_widths = c(0.5,1,1,0.8 ))
plot

ggsave('figures/CN depth.pdf',plot,width=8,height=6)
```

```{r geochemistry time series}

# load age-depth model results 
load('results/age-depth model outputs/age-depth_alldata.Rdata')

# load CN geochem results for core 
CN=readxl::read_xlsx('data/CN results/CN_geochem_results.xlsx') %>% mutate(dataset='2025')
CN = CN %>% mutate(elev_msl = GR19C1_coretop_MSL-depth_cm/100) # create elevation column

# predict ages at LOI depths
CNages = predict(age_depth,
                  newPositions = CN$depth_cm)

# mean predicted age at all CN depths
calcMeanAge = function(x) {
  ages=CNages[,x]
  meanage=mean(ages)
  return(meanage)
}

# sd predicted age at all CN depths
calcSdAge = function(x) {
  ages=CNages[,x]
  meanage=sd(ages)
  return(meanage)
}

toapply=array(1:ncol(CNages))

CNmeanages = apply(X=toapply,MARGIN=1,FUN=calcMeanAge)
CNsdages=apply(X=toapply,MARGIN=1,FUN=calcSdAge)
CN=mutate(CN,age=CNmeanages,sd_age=CNsdages)

pd13C_time = 
  ggplot(data=CN,
               aes(y=d13C,
                x=age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_reverse()+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=15,face='bold'),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=15,face='bold')) +
  labs(x='Age (cal yrs BP)',y='d13C')

pd15N_time = 
  ggplot(data=CN,
               aes(y=d15N,
                x=age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_reverse()+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=15,face='bold'),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=15,face='bold')) +
  labs(x='Age (cal yrs BP)',y='d15N')

pCN_time = 
  ggplot(data=CN,
               aes(y=CN,
                x=age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_reverse()+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=15,face='bold'),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=15,face='bold')) +
  labs(x='Age (cal yrs BP)',y='C/N')

CN_time=cowplot::plot_grid(pd13C_time,pd15N_time,pCN_time,
                   nrow=3,
                   align='h')
CN_time

ggsave('figures/CN timeseries.pdf',CN_time,width=6,height=8)


```
